name: CSS Horizontal Scroll Section
description: A section that scrolls horizontally while the page scrolls vertically, pure CSS: a tall wrapper creates scroll room, a sticky inner pins the viewport, and a view() timeline drives the sideways translate of a wide strip.
usage:
Include styles.css, then wrap your panels in the three-layer shell:
panels
. Every direct child of .shs-track is one stop on the ride; tune ride length with the shs-scroll-length custom property and strip width with shs-track-width (set it to max-content to fit the panels exactly).
